q: Which size is right for me?
a: Travel (3.4 fl oz / 100 mL) is the first bottle most people buy and fits any gear bag. Pro (8.5 fl oz / 250 mL) is the daily-training bottle and our most popular size. Coach (17 fl oz / 500 mL) is built for therapists, fight gyms and team training rooms.

q: How do I use Athlon Rub?
a: Shake the bottle well. Pump a small amount into your palm, then work it into the muscles and joints you are about to load. A little goes a long way. Give it a minute to absorb, then put your kit on. For the strongest warming sensation, apply after a brief sweat or a warm shower, and re-apply between rounds as needed.

q: How is this different from a typical recovery rub?
a: Most products on the recovery shelf are FDA-classified as counter-irritants, which work by creating a distracting sensation. Athlon Rub is a working liniment: an oil-based formula of naturally derived botanicals with a clean warming sensation that builds with your own body temperature.

q: Will it stain my kit or feel greasy?
a: It is formulated to absorb fast and to be non-greasy and non-staining. There are no added colorants, so clothes, gis, towels and sheets stay clean. It is designed to be worn under clothing, including through intense sessions.

q: Can I use it before competition?
a: Athlon Rub is produced under ISO guidelines in an FDA-registered lab in the USA and is third-party tested for banned substances for professional athletic use. Always check the rules of your own sport and event before competing.

q: Can I use it with tape or wraps?
a: Yes. Apply, give it a minute to absorb, then tape or wrap. Because it is non-greasy it will not get in the way of adhesion.
